items.note: The plan gives the copy, side-injection, gather and scatter maps, the eight-row subtract/add/restore schedule, the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 with the side wires cancelling the remaining cases, and the three-stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), as in the proof at 741-764. The wire counts W_b, W_c are not given, but they are not part of the lemma's content.

It states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, including auxiliary roles. It derives them by the paper's invariant: edges change frame, and a common frame commutes with the pointwise gate.

It has the forms, nondegeneracy and orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines, the terminal sums N and Wm-N, the stage transitions, the single central loss of h, L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L, the orthonormal bases and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. It omits the per-time gate labels (eq:motif-labels) and the side-wire chain P⊗<t_X> ⊂ P⊗t_Y^⊥, where neighbour orthogonality is used. So the claim that only the central 3->4 edges decrease is asserted, not verified edge by edge as in 1012-1068.

It covers M_v=P_U, the source matrices -P_{U_a}, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N rank-one exceptions 2P_{U_a}, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, all as in 1156-1172. S2.2.4 loosely calls the projections themselves 'frames'; the address-shear frame Phi_M only appears in S3.3.

It follows the proof: weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, odd weight of norm-one vectors, H diag(1,-1) H = X giving aI+bX_v, the k-column tensor power, the X_a->Y_a exception with C^{-1} on 27 coordinates corrected by Z and i^{27k}, then negating outputs. The count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c and the deficit 2N-2L_c are correct.

L/N<1/2 gives the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, and then s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} via m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}). The explicit deficits eta_b=339/22587335000000 and eta_c=73/19906842167500 are not given, and neither is the reason log m<20 behind the exponential inequality (1331-1338). The step is marked partial for that reason.

Both lemmas are stated correctly: digit permutations, moves, split/merge, cyclic row splitting into W streams, and controlled shifts y->y+a(controls) with b^{O(1)} offset preparation and unit scalings in O(V). No proof is sketched; the method only says they are stated once.

The shear-cost derivation matches 1432-1447: triangular parts by controlled shifts, then one interchange per one of Pi via D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j. Two parts are missing. The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 is only stated; its elimination proof (topmost row, rightmost pivot, 1375-1392) is not given. The choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding the denominators (1413-1423) is also absent.

Every step of the proof is present: the cyclic row split with row count divisible by W^{k-1}, Phi_{A_e} on each edge via the matrix shear with recursive interchanges, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D on every row, the three updates giving the interchange, s calls on volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the a<=1 / a>1 cases, and the fixed-tape parking stack.

The base-m piece decomposition, the row padding to a multiple of W^k and the cost sum O(V)Σa_j m^{jτ}=O(Ve^τ) are right. The step compresses the high-digit construction into 'peel off the top ρ digits as a row index'. It omits that the high parts are interchanged pairwise and joined into a row field (d^+,h^+) of range q^{2ρ}≥W^k, then separated again (1662-1700). It also orders the binary-to-q^e padding after the interchange, although the paper sets it up first.

It covers the edge product of directional kernels, conjugation by P_M placing the residual directions in slots, one child per direction on f=e/m chunks, inverse children via (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z^{⊗f}C^{⊗f}Z^{⊗f}, exactly s_c children with C^{⊗e} on every role, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The Gaussian-elimination count of row additions (1890-1898) is only implicit in S4.6.5.

It has the eight modular additions with result (u+c(1-2(u mod 2)),w), the guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, δ_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, repair by key-sorting the extracted records, and the O(V((eK)^τ+1)) change-of-basis cost. Three parts are missing: the argument that S_0,T_0 are bijections agreeing off B, so T_0S_0^{-1} permutes B; the chunk swaps that move the target after its controls (the source of the L^τ term); and the separate handling of the top selected bit j_{f-1}.

It matches 2306-2448: q_0 preprocessed chunks used as a row index of range at least W^{k_0}, rows split u=Wg+w, children of volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) with leaves O(e) for e<d^β, internal costs O(e^λ) from K<=e^{c/β}, leaves O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), and the base-m partition giving O(d^{λ'}).

It states the H_0 layer on D<=d chunks returned as Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{λ'}) with error below √2·2^{-p}, and exact evaluation with C_0 d^{C_1}=o(p) guard bits. The depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, E=64(W+m+1)^3, A(e)<=8e and sx+E<=(s+E)x follow 2460-2586, and the row-sum-one disk argument is present.

It covers ω_t=y^{2r/t}, character cancellation via the shift by t/2^{v+1}, the DIF step with bit-reversed output B_t, the reversed procedure giving F_t^+B_t^{-1}, grouped rounds with J_E, the layout L by prefix moves and at most Dq-1 width-K exchanges, the costs, single truncation per round, and LBF^-, F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, all as in the paper.

The derivation follows the paper: B_0=2^{4p}, 4pr-bit evaluation integers, four products, |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2 for centered extraction, and reduction mod y^r+1. The statement says the product is 'computed exactly' but does not say that the returned value is Q_p(fg/r), with error below √2·2^{-p}.

It has two forward transforms kept in the common LB order (pointwise product commutes with LB), the packed products, the opposite transform and the exact scale by M. The normalization F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) and the error bound 3δ+η scaled to √2M(3ℓ+1)2^{-p} match 3414-3460, and the cost appears in S5.

It covers the Gaussian identity T P_s F_s=P_t F_t S, the Neumann inversion of N=CTD, the normalizations giving A=S' and B_0=D'J'C with factor 2^{-2α^2}, unexecuted permutations, tensoring to RF_s=2^γ B_0 Q F_t A, the per-line cost sum, and axis exposure by chunk swaps at O(Tp d^2(1+ℓ^τ)). One cost attribution in S6.1.3 is loose; see errors.

It derives the chirp period, the Bluestein coefficient identity including Q's frequency -s_i j_i, F_q^+ R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+ for units, RF_s^+R=F_s^+, and (u*v)/S^2 from the convolution rule, as in 3938-3980.

All fixed exponents, b, p=6b, d, K, T, r, t_i and α, γ, η=1/(4d) are as in the paper. The derivation of prime existence (Rosser-Schoenfeld bound ηx/(2 log x)>d), T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, α^4θ_i>p, the n^{o(1)} trial-division search and the no-wraparound degree bound follows 4103-4193.

It derives that Φ is an isomorphism (order S, units μ_i), the triangular b_i formula, updates from i=d down by prefix-controlled cyclic shifts fixing the padding, and the O(Tp d^2(1+ℓ^τ)) cost with axis exchanges, matching 4216-4291.

It derives that Θ is well defined, diagonal and an isometric isomorphism, the wrap identity ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h=ζ^j, and M_C=D_- ι^{-1} M_r(ι D_+ f, ι D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, plus the computed twist and untwist. The twist error bound below 4 is not stated here.

It covers the source transform (A, chirp transform via twist and convolution, B_0, scale 2^γ), its exact counterpart RF_s, conjugation for F^+, and the six-step algorithm. The step list correctly gives the digit scale 2^{p-b-2}, Φ, two transforms, pointwise product, F^+ and ×S, ×2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Φ^{-1} and carries. The summary in S8.2 drops the second S; S8.2.4 has it.

It covers the disk margins (.7/.701), chirp error 8TL, E_s=9·2^γ TL, pointwise error 2E_s+2, E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28·2^γ T^2 L, the final bound 448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2, unique rounding and the carry invariant. E_ring<5TL is not stated, and γ<=b/4 is replaced by γ=o(b), which holds eventually.

It has the cost table rows, the margins g_1..g_7 with their values, min g = g_2=2^{-181}=2κ, setup and exceptional sorting as o(Tp), polylog absorbed by p^κ, O(Tp·p^{1-κ}), and the schoolbook cutoff, all as in the paper.

No step says the bound refutes an eventual n lg n lower bound or mentions liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0. Only S0's 'relies on: nlogn-conjecture' tag and its Θ(n log n) motivation touch the topic. Conservatively absent.

errors.says: Because the sparse Gaussian window has radius ⌈√p⌉α, the quoted maps S̃', J̃', D̃' all cost O(tp^{3/2+δ}α).
errors.paper: The time bounds come from the cited Lemmas 4.8, 4.9 and 4.12, with D̃' costing only O(tp^{1+δ}). The radius-⌈√p⌉α window concerns the tape movement of the S' procedure alone.

errors.says: The algorithm ... rescales by S and 2^{2b+4}.
errors.paper: The second rescaling is by 2^{2b+4}S, so S occurs twice, undoing (u*v)/S^2. S8.2.4 and S8.2.5 state this correctly.

errors.says: Peel off the top ρ digits of each chunk as a row index, ... interchange each pair by the power-width procedure, then undo the padding and pad binary ranges to the radix q.
errors.paper: The high parts are first interchanged digit pair by digit pair and joined into a row field (d^+,h^+), and separated again at the end. Padding binary ranges to [q^e] is the initial reduction, not a final step.

errors.says: Using the projections P_U onto the labels as frames.
errors.paper: The projections are the vertex matrices M_v=P_U. The frames are the invertible address shears Φ_{M_v}: (H,D)->(H+M_vD,D). A projection itself is not invertible.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: the networks with labels and the rank saving, the interchange and layer recurrences, the synthetic transforms and convolution, resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation, the CRT layout, the algorithm, exact recovery, then time accounting to O(n(lg n)^{1-κ}). It thins out in a few places. The label construction asserts the 'only central 3->4 edges decrease' fact without the gate-label table or the side-wire nesting. The arbitrary-width reduction compresses the high-digit exchange. The packed addition omits the bijection argument behind the repair. The step from the time bound to refuting the n log n conjecture is absent.

steps.note: It has the banks indexed by triples of 3-subsets, m=10^6, the fixed linear schedule giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), and restoration of every scratch value. h=100 and N=binom(h,3)^3 are never stated explicitly, although N is used later.
It has a common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and edges costing only D_v D_u^{-1}.

It has nondegenerate subspace labels of the m-dimensional space with tensor-form stage labels, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h. The per-time gate-label table is not reproduced.
It has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the only exceptions.
It has source sum N, sink sum Wm-N, signed sum Wm-2N, L=Ich, absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, with deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, hence s<Wm.
It has the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m on X_a and 0->I elsewhere, so via Φ_M frames the network applies H<-H+D on every role, scratch rows included.
It has A=E_1 Pi E_2, the triangular parts at O(V), one interchange per one of Pi, hence exactly rank(A) recursive interchanges per edge and s calls per node.

It has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), deficits above 20·2^{-50}, and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}) giving s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}, hence F_k=O(e^τ). The justification log m<20 is implicit rather than stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain. It covers the triple-indexed exchange network restoring its scratch wires, frames commuting with pointwise gates, nested nondegenerate labels with the only loss h on central 3->4 edges, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, L/N=100/539 or 101/539 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity I_m producing H<-H+D, rank-many interchanges per edge via E_1 Pi E_2, and the recurrence with s/W<m^τ, τ=1-2^{-50}. Its gaps are details: h=100 and N are never defined, the gate-label table is omitted, and log m<20 is left implicit.
